blocks.orig: In the central part of Serengeti National Park, near the Orangi River, lies Baobab Central Serengeti Camp an intimate camp that gets visited from time to time by giraffes, zebras and even elephants. It features 17 self-contained, fully furnished wooden safari tents, three of which are ideal for families or groups as they accommodate up to six guests. All tents are equipped with queen-size beds, free Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with flushing toilets and showers, verandas with chairs, and electricity and hot water generated exclusively through solar energy. The main tent houses the reception, a restaurant with delicious breakfasts and dinner, a lounge for reading and relaxation, and a bar. Additionally, just in front of the camp, a fireplace invites you to comfortably enjoy the magic of every starry night.
blocks.html: Close to the Orangi River in central Serengeti National Park, you find Baobab Central Serengeti Camp, an intimate camp where giraffes, zebras and even elephants drop by now and then. There are 17 self-contained wooden safari tents, all fully furnished, and three of them can sleep up to six guests, which makes them ideal for families or groups. Every tent has queen-size beds, free Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with a flushing toilet and shower, a veranda with chairs, and electricity and hot water produced entirely by solar power. In the main tent you find the reception, a restaurant serving tasty breakfasts and dinners, a lounge for reading and relaxing, and a bar. And right in front of the camp, a fireplace is the perfect spot to enjoy the magic of each starry night in comfort.
